# SHUUL

> We build software that makes complexity invisible. SHUUL Technologies LLP is a small team in Pune, Maharashtra, India, engineering human-fluent, AI-native systems. We make a small number of products and look after them.

Site: https://shuul.io

## Products

- [Murmie](https://murmie.com/): Product 00. Free, private, on-device voice dictation for macOS (Apple silicon, no account). Double-tap Right ⌘, speak, and your words appear wherever you're typing.
- [SuperHospitality](https://superhospitality.in/): Product 01, live. "Run your hotel in perfect sync." An AI concierge your guests already know how to use, with a real person one tap away. It works over voice, WhatsApp or a web app, in the guest's language, on top of the property system the hotel already runs.

## Company

- Legal entity: SHUUL Technologies LLP, Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Founder: Vinay Punera (https://www.linkedin.com/in/vinaypunera/)
- DPIIT-recognised startup under the Startup India initiative
- Member of Razorpay Rize; selected for AWS Activate and Google for Startups
- SuperHospitality is running in live hotels in India
